text:
Maya Singh: Kicking off a short thread to align on marketplace launch playbook + partner GTM. Goal: coordinated announce across AWS/GCP/Azure + 1 hardware partner + SI demo week.
Rajiv Kapoor: timeline check: target public announce Fri Jul 8 09:00 PT, embargo for partners Thu Jul 7 08:00 PT. We need marketplace certs in by Jun 28.
Zoe Lin: copy/design owners: Marketing will do hero + assets. I'll supply screenshots and latency charts. Deliver initial assets by Jun 10.
Paul Ng: marketplace owner note: AWS + Azure + GCP each need slightly different artifacts. I'll start Azure + AWS submissions on Jun 12, Zoe take GCP.
Maya Singh: partner comms: hardware partner (NVIDIA) bench graphic + optional quote. Paul, can you request logo/quote approvals by Jun 5?
Paul Ng: yes. will ping partner comms today. Also need signed logo MOU before we publish.
legal-bot: Reminder: submit embargoed PR + partner quote approvals to Legal (legal@redwood.ai) by Jun 3 for 48h review.
Rajiv Kapoor: events: plan a partner co-hosted webinar the week after launch (Jul 11-15). We'll use the webinar to convert SI pipeline.
Zoe Lin: page checklist: hero, 3 product bullets, partner tiles, benchmark callout, gated demo + trial CTAs, press kit. Draft copy by Jun 10, QA by Jun 20.
Maya Singh: owners summary: Marketplace subs -> Paul. GCP assets -> Zoe. Marketing copy/page -> Rajiv. Partner coordination -> Maya. Legal review -> legal-bot.
Paul Ng: risks: marketplace cert delays, partner logo signoff, data embargo slip. Mitigation: staggered publish (partners first) + backup blog content.
Zoe Lin: I'll upload screenshots to /shared/marketing/marketplace by Jun 8.
Maya Singh: action items: 1) Paul submit AWS/Azure by Jun 12 2) Zoe upload assets by Jun 8 3) Rajiv draft PR & landing copy by Jun 10 4) Partners provide logo/quote approvals by Jun 5 5) Legal review by Jun 3.
legal-bot: Calendar invite: "Marketplace GTM sync" weekly starting May 26, Wednesdays 9am PT. Owners invited.
Rajiv Kapoor: noted. i'll create a short Asana board and tag owners.
Paul Ng: will request expedited marketplace review if cert timelines slip.
Maya Singh: thanks all, please post blockers here. :rocket:
